findingDetails.title: REQ-003 third missed doc: phase-system knowledge node restates both thresholds without the series-parent exception
findingDetails.claim: The feature-catalog knowledge node restates both phase-qualification thresholds (score >= 25 of 50, level >= 3) at line 29 and never names the series-parent exception; REQ-003 requires every doc that restates the thresholds to name it. Third affected file beyond the two registered in R1-P1-003; survived the packet's own threshold-wording sweep.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The node is a condensed layer over phase-system.md (which names the exception at :36) and its source table lists both updated docs; the sweep over every skill markdown stating the threshold wording returned exactly this file as the only miss.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: If the catalog convention exempts summary nodes that link an updated source doc, the fix is regeneration rather than a manual edit.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the feature-catalog convention exempts summary nodes that link the updated source doc, collapse to P2 or close as a regeneration artifact.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the exception sentence to line 29 (or regenerate the node from phase-system.md) and widen the sweep to the feature-catalog tree.

findingDetails.title: 006 spec.md scope tables omit spec-folder-authoring-checklist.md, which the packet actually modified
findingDetails.claim: In-Scope (:76) and Files-to-Change (:89-101) never name references/workflows/spec-folder-authoring-checklist.md, while implementation-summary.md:65 records it as Modified and the file carries the fix at :44. Completion record and scope record disagree about the changed set.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: REQ-003's every-doc wording always implied the checklist; the fix-sweep addition is legitimate scope completion recorded in the summary. Only the spec tables were not reconciled.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Files-to-Change may be the planned set by design, with fix-sweep additions living in the summary.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If packet convention treats the summary as the canonical changed-set record, this closes as optional doc cleanup.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the checklist row to In Scope and Files to Change at close-out, or state that fix-sweep additions are reconciled into implementation-summary.md.
